name: Message Function 9 Code
definition: Identifies the message function within a card payment exchange.

RJCQ.name: Acceptor Request Reject
RJCQ.definition: Reject of a request or an advice message by an acquirer or an agent.

RJCP.name: Acceptor Response Reject
RJCP.definition: Reject of a response or an advice response message by a card acceptor or an agent.
